text: The Civic Appointments Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board: EPL2-119 EPL2-152 EPL2-153 EPL2-155 EPL2-161 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (September 23, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board.
